blocks.text: 1 Chronicles 2 contains 55 verses. It opens with: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun, It concludes with: And the families of scribes that dwelt at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, the Sucathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: The genealogies are selective literary maps of kinship, land, office, and restored identity rather than exhaustive modern biological pedigrees; gaps, parallel lines, variant names, and telescoping require case-by-case review.
